subject: sudden failure to create shared library

messages.author: 4a635fe980c8c1cd
messages.subject: sudden failure to create shared library
parts:
Hi all,

I've suddenly starting bumping into the following error--related to the R terminal executable, I think?--when trying to compile nimbleModels

> foo <- nimbleFunction( run = function(x = double(1)) {return(sum(x)); returnType(double())})
> cfoo <- compileNimble(foo)
Compiling
  [Note] This may take a minute.
  [Note] Use 'showCompilerOutput = TRUE' to see C++ compilation details.
Error: Failed to create the shared library. Run 'printErrors()' to see the compilation errors.
> printErrors()
'"C:\PROGRA~1\R\R-40~1.3/bin/x64/Rterm.exe"' is not recognized as an internal or external command,
operable program or batch file.

My intuition is that the R terminal executable has some how gone missing (there is no Rterm.exe in the x64 binary folder; there is an r terminal executable in R's x386 binary folder, and I can compile smaller models through R x386).  This is a shared server and I can't write/edit the main drive--wondering if the best solution is a re-install, or whether I should look for that .exe somewhere and change the path, or whether there's some other issue?

Thanks,

John
